amlRiskScoring.name: Customer AML risk scoring
amlRiskScoring.purpose: Classifies customers by money laundering risk based on their transaction profile and source of funds, setting the level of AML monitoring.

biometricIdVerification.name: Biometric identity verification
biometricIdVerification.purpose: Verifies the customer's identity in the remote channel by comparing the ID document photo with facial biometrics before a financial product is opened.

branchBookingBot.name: Appointment booking bot
branchBookingBot.purpose: Allows customers to book a branch appointment themselves.

candidatePrescreeningChatbot.name: Candidate pre-screening chatbot
candidatePrescreeningChatbot.purpose: Asks candidates basic screening questions before passing their CV to a recruiter, without any automated rejection decision.

complaintsAssistant.name: Complaints assistant
complaintsAssistant.purpose: Collects complaint details from the customer and pre-categorises the case before handing it over to an agent.

contentModeration.name: Automated content moderation
contentModeration.purpose: Automatically classifies and removes reported user content for compliance with the platform's terms of use, without human review in most cases.

customerOnboardingAssistant.name: Customer onboarding assistant
customerOnboardingAssistant.purpose: Guides new customers step by step through the process of opening a product or account.

cvRanking.name: CV analysis and ranking
cvRanking.purpose: Automatically scores and ranks submitted CVs against the job requirements, indicating to the recruiter which candidates should proceed to the next stage.

debtCollectionSegmentation.name: Debt collection risk segmentation
debtCollectionSegmentation.purpose: Segments debtors in arrears by likelihood of repayment and recommends a collection strategy (soft, hard, debt assignment).

documentFormatConversion.name: Document format conversion
documentFormatConversion.purpose: Converts documents between PDF, Word and Excel formats at an employee's request.

documentTagging.name: Document tagging
documentTagging.purpose: Automatically assigns subject tags to documents entering the archive.

documentTranslation.name: Document translation
documentTranslation.purpose: Translates working documents between Polish and English.

duplicateDetection.name: Duplicate detection
duplicateDetection.purpose: Flags potential duplicate records in the customer database for verification by an employee.

emailClassification.name: Email classification
emailClassification.purpose: Automatically categorises incoming emails by subject and priority.

emailReplyGenerator.name: Email reply generator
emailReplyGenerator.purpose: Prepares draft replies to incoming customer emails for approval by an agent.

employeePerformanceReview.name: Employee performance review
employeePerformanceReview.purpose: Aggregates employee performance data (objectives, line manager ratings, metrics) and generates a performance review recommendation that affects promotion or bonus.

employeeSocialScoring.name: Employee social scoring system
employeeSocialScoring.purpose: Rates employees for “loyalty” and “cultural fit” based on their activity in internal channels (chat, email, log-ins) and calculates an aggregate HR risk score.

formAutofill.name: Form autofill
formAutofill.purpose: Suggests values for internal form fields based on previously entered data.

hrSelfServiceAssistant.name: HR self-service assistant
hrSelfServiceAssistant.purpose: Answers employees' questions about HR policies, leave and benefits.

insuranceRiskAssessment.name: Insurance risk assessment
insuranceRiskAssessment.purpose: Estimates the level of risk and proposes the insurance premium based on the customer profile and claims history.

internalChatAssistant.name: Internal chat assistant
internalChatAssistant.purpose: Helps employees find internal information and procedures through the company chat.

internalDocSummarization.name: Internal document summarisation
internalDocSummarization.purpose: Generates short summaries of long internal documents for quick review.

interviewShortlisting.name: Interview shortlisting
interviewShortlisting.purpose: Shortlists candidates for a job interview based on their answers in the pre-screening form and an analysis of their CV.

invoiceDataExtraction.name: Invoice data extraction
invoiceDataExtraction.purpose: Reads data from invoices (amounts, NIP, dates) and enters it into the accounting system.

jobDescriptionGenerator.name: Job description generator
jobDescriptionGenerator.purpose: Creates draft job adverts based on a short brief from the hiring manager.

knowledgeBaseAssistant.name: Knowledge base assistant
knowledgeBaseAssistant.purpose: Finds and summarises relevant articles from the internal knowledge base for the agent.

leasingCreditworthiness.name: Leasing creditworthiness assessment
leasingCreditworthiness.purpose: Assesses the leasing creditworthiness of business customers based on financial statements and payment history.

letterProofreading.name: Letter proofreading
letterProofreading.purpose: Checks company correspondence for language and style before it is sent.

marketingContentGenerator.name: Marketing content generator
marketingContentGenerator.purpose: Creates draft marketing content (posts, newsletters) for approval by the marketing team.

medicalTriage.name: Medical request triage
medicalTriage.purpose: Prioritises the order in which medical helpline requests are handled based on the description of symptoms, affecting the time to access care.

meetingSchedulingAssistant.name: Meeting scheduling assistant
meetingSchedulingAssistant.purpose: Proposes and books meetings with an adviser based on calendar availability.

meetingTranscription.name: Meeting transcription
meetingTranscription.purpose: Creates transcripts and notes of internal meetings from audio recordings.

mortgageAssessment.name: Mortgage application assessment
mortgageAssessment.purpose: Analyses mortgage applications (income, deposit, property valuation) and prepares a preliminary recommendation on the lending terms.

offerAdvisor.name: Offer adviser
offerAdvisor.purpose: Compares available offers and presents the customer with a recommendation in plain language.

predictiveCustomerProfiling.name: Predictive behavioural customer profiling
predictiveCustomerProfiling.purpose: Predicts customers' future purchasing and financial behaviour using behavioural data from outside the context in which it was originally collected, and automatically changes the terms of the offer.

productDescriptionGenerator.name: Product description generator
productDescriptionGenerator.purpose: Creates draft product descriptions for the catalogue based on technical data.

productFaqBot.name: Product FAQ bot
productFaqBot.purpose: Answers frequently asked questions about products based on the knowledge base.

reportSummaries.name: Report summaries
reportSummaries.purpose: Generates summaries of periodic operational reports for senior management.

retailCreditScoring.name: Retail credit scoring
retailCreditScoring.purpose: Automatically assesses the creditworthiness of retail applicants based on their BIK history, income and liabilities, generating a recommended credit decision.

reviewSentimentAnalysis.name: Review sentiment analysis
reviewSentimentAnalysis.purpose: Classifies the sentiment (positive, negative, neutral) of customer reviews collected from surveys.

satisfactionSurveyBot.name: Satisfaction survey bot
satisfactionSurveyBot.purpose: Collects and pre-categorises customer responses to satisfaction surveys (NPS/CSAT).

semanticKnowledgeSearch.name: Semantic knowledge search
semanticKnowledgeSearch.purpose: Enables natural-language search of the company knowledge base.

socialBenefitsEligibility.name: Social benefits eligibility
socialBenefitsEligibility.purpose: Assesses employees' applications for benefits from the Company Social Benefits Fund (ZFŚS) against the income criteria.

socialMediaPostGenerator.name: Social media post generator
socialMediaPostGenerator.purpose: Prepares draft social media posts in line with brand guidelines.

techSupportChatbot.name: Technical support chatbot
techSupportChatbot.purpose: Guides the customer through basic troubleshooting steps before escalating to an agent.

tenantScreening.name: Tenant screening
tenantScreening.purpose: Assesses the financial reliability of prospective commercial property tenants based on payment history and financial data.

ticketSorting.name: Ticket sorting
ticketSorting.purpose: Automatically sorts incoming internal tickets by category and urgency.

transactionFraudDetection.name: Transaction fraud detection
transactionFraudDetection.purpose: Monitors payment transactions in real time and flags suspicious patterns as potential fraud for review by an analyst.

virtualProductAdvisor.name: Virtual product adviser
virtualProductAdvisor.purpose: Recommends products tailored to the customer's needs based on a short questionnaire.

websiteChatAssistant.name: Website chat assistant
websiteChatAssistant.purpose: Answers website visitors' questions about the product range and directs them to the right department.
